report.company_overview: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) is a public sector undertaking under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, operating as a group company of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL). It is a downstream petroleum company engaged in refining crude oil to produce and supply a wide spectrum of petroleum products, including fuels, lubricants, waxes, and petrochemical feedstocks.
mgmt_priorities: Operating the refinery efficiently in a safe, reliable and environmentally responsible manner
Adhering to optimum return on value-added and growth projects
Honouring commitment to create long-term value for shareholders
competitive_advantages: Fully integrated refinery complex at Manali encompassing fuel, lube base oil, wax, and petrochemical feedstock production
Strategic advantage with Manali refinery location, well-positioned for southern India and proximity to major ports
Association with IOCL providing financial stability, assured crude supply, and marketing support
Diversified product slate including niche products
growth_drivers: Forward integration into retail fuel marketing
Collaboration with IOCL to set up a 9 MMTPA new grassroot refinery with integrated petrochemical capabilities at Nagapattinam
Group II/III Lube Oil Base Stock (LOBS) project
Low-cost debottlenecking and enhancement of secondary processes
recent_developments: Upgraded from Schedule B to Schedule A Category PSU company effective 01.08.2024
Commissioned Dual Divided Wall Column (DWC) in the existing Isomerization unit for Pharma Grade Hexane production
Initiated 1.1MW floating solar project on reservoirs
Received 'Innovator of the Year – Special Commendation' at FIPI event for JP-7 and ISROSENE
Achieved highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY 2025-26

citations.quote: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL), a prominent public sector undertaking under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, operates as a group company of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL).

Company’s significant revenues are derived from sales to oil marketing companies which is 96.47% and 96.78% of the Company's sales related to petroleum products for the year ending March 31, 2025 & March 31, 2024 respectively.

CPCL stands as a critical player in India's downstream petroleum sector, offering a wide spectrum of refined products that serve industrial, commercial, and domestic requirements. Through its association with IOCL, CPCL supplies a range of essential fuels including Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Motor Spirit (petrol), Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF), and High-Speed Diesel to meet diverse consumer demands. In addition, CPCL directly markets select specialty products such as Paraffin Wax, Mineral Turpentine Oil (MTO),Food Grade & Pharma Grade Hexane , and petrochemical feedstocks

While these are broader factors that may drive volatility, we remain at CPCL focused on things we can control, and that is operating our refinery efficiently in a safe, reliable and environmentally responsible manner and continue to focus on key matrix such as controlling the operating costs as well as maintaining capital discipline by adhering to optimum return on value added and growth projects and thereby honouring our commitment to create long-term value for our shareholders.

CPCL enjoys a strategic advantage with its Manali refinery, which is well-positioned to meet the energy demands of southern India while benefiting from efficient logistics through its proximity to major ports.
I am delighted to announce that your Company has been upgraded from Schedule B to Schedule A Category PSU company on 01.08.2024.
